suite: native generation cgroup upstream applicability review

primary_sources.finding: cgroup-v2 opens are relative to a pinned cgroup root with BENEATH/NO_MAGICLINKS/NO_XDEV/NO_SYMLINKS resolution; filesystem checks reject ordinary files in its alternate path
primary_sources.application: pin each acknowledged generation group, require actual cgroup-v2 descriptors and constrained openat2 for control members; unsupported operations refuse without a pathname fallback

primary_sources.finding: resolution flags constrain descriptor-relative traversal and can forbid links and mount crossings
primary_sources.application: require these fences for each static cgroup control member

primary_sources.finding: cgroup.kill SIGKILLs the cgroup tree; deleted groups can remain dying and cannot revive
primary_sources.application: acknowledge actual inode and boot before limits/join/spawn or kill; actual child reaping and final path absence are additional requirements

implemented: serde-default actual supervisor/VM cgroup receipts persisted before subsequent effects
same-boot and exact inode recovery; unrecorded or replaced objects preserved
descriptor-relative budget/procs/events/kill operations on actual cgroup-v2 objects
VM collection preflight before direct PID signals and identical Machine Drop fence
two actual local descriptor/refusal checks plus an explicitly ignored dedicated owned-cgroup mutation/Drop test
